title: Comfort Club Reinstatement Surcharge for Forfeited Tune-Ups
content:
A Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement whose lapsed term holds forfeited tune-up visits carries a surcharge on reinstatement.

## Forfeit surcharge rule
Count the visits in the lapsed term that were forfeited by a no-show or by a late cancellation.

| Forfeited visits in the lapsed term | Surcharge added |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 15.00 USD (the repeat surcharge) |
| Exactly one | 5.00 USD (the single surcharge) |
| None | nothing |

Only visits recorded as forfeited for a no-show or a late cancellation and charged to the lapsed term count.

## Examples (hypothetical lapsed terms)
- One heating tune-up missed with no one home: 5.00 added.
- A late-cancelled cooling tune-up and a later no-show: 15.00 added.
- Three forfeits in the lapsed term: still 15.00.
- A forfeit in an earlier term only: nothing added for this lapsed term.
